data.name: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 1
data.detailed_description:
Discover your lovely adventuring RPG

Welcome to your fairy-tale haven, a stress-free sanctuary where failure simply does not exist. Prepare for a lovely adventuring RPG that will instantly wrap you in a serene, heartwarming atmosphere after a demanding day. Forget about ticking clocks or frustrating hurdles. This is your digital retreat—a wholesome journey you can enjoy entirely without haste and at your own pace, perhaps with a nice cup of tea.

Save the town and protect little Brent

During your travels, you arrive in a picturesque town recently struck by an unexpected disaster—a mythical dragon's attack. While most of the frightened residents seek shelter, you meet a young orphaned boy named Brent. His eyes shine with grand dreams of bravery and heroism. Take him under your wing and embark on a special adventure together into the mysterious wilderness. Your good deeds and gentle guidance will help shape this young orphan into a true hero.

A return to classic roots and thoughtful planning

Instead of brute force, this journey relies on your wits and careful planning. An incredibly accessible and intuitive point-and-click experience awaits you, where a single click or touch is all it takes. Thoughtfully gather supplies, explore every corner of the beautifully detailed isometric landscape, and lend a helping hand to those in need. This installment proudly returns to the purest roots of the series—resources do not respawn and your tools never break, allowing you to peacefully focus on overcoming obstacles and gradually healing the world around you.

What awaits you on this journey

  • A focused experience for a cozy evening: A smooth, cohesive story without unnecessary wandering, fully respecting your time.

  • A loyal companion by your side: Experience an emotional journey and protect little Brent on his quest for justice.

  • The gratification of restoration: Feel a deeply rewarding joy from your good deeds, and watch the landscape beautifully transform with every helping hand you lend.

  • Time in your hands: Play entirely at your own pace, free from any time limits or the need for quick reflexes.

  • Classic gameplay without the rush: Enjoy intuitive controls, thoughtful resource gathering, and clever planning in a serene world where every item holds meaning.
